details: Global stock markets showed stability on Thursday, August 27, 2026, driven by a strong sales forecast from Nvidia that bolstered technology shares. However, broader trade was subdued by ongoing geopolitical uncertainty and data indicating stubbornly high inflation in the U.S., which remains above the Federal Reserve's target. In the cryptocurrency market, Bitcoin saw a 0.5% increase to $78,802, briefly surpassing the $80,000 mark this week, its first time in over three months. Ether also climbed by 0.8% to $2,493. Both cryptocurrencies are benefiting from a resurgence of "dollar debasement trades" following interventions by the U.S. Treasury Department in bond markets last week. Oil prices have also gradually eased due to negotiations between Iran and Oman, raising hopes for restored commercial traffic through the Strait of Hormuz, which could reduce the geopolitical risk premium on crude.
title: Global Markets Steady, Crypto Rises Amid Geopolitical Uncertainty and Inflation Concerns

details: U.S. inflation remained at 3.7% in July, staying above the Federal Reserve's target. Meanwhile, Meta Platforms agreed to a significant settlement and platform changes in a youth addiction lawsuit. In other economic news, Canadian officials welcomed a U.S. shift regarding French language discoverability in trade talks, and Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook publicly denounced claims of mortgage fraud made by Donald Trump. Negotiations between Iran and Oman were noted for their potential impact on oil prices.
title: US Inflation Holds at 3.7%, Meta Settles Youth Addiction Case
